sentences.en: I got punched in the ribs and it hurt pretty badly.
sentences.zh: 我挨了一拳打在肋骨上，疼得厉害。

sentences.en: Dan fell to the ground and broke three ribs.
sentences.zh: 丹摔倒在地上，断了三根肋骨。

sentences.en: Corduroy is a thick cotton fabric with velvety ribs.
sentences.zh: 卡其布是一种厚棉织物，表面有天鹅绒般的凸条花纹。

senses.zh: 肋骨；（船、伞等的）肋；（织物的）凸条纹
